description: Prove a consequence, by action: "now" evaluates a predicate against the window that already exists, "wait" waits for one to become true within a budget. e.g. {"action":"now"}

intent.description: What this change is meant to make true — as a durable statement ABOUT THE PRODUCT, or the id of an intent you already declared.

predicate.description: Predicate object: { kind, ...fields }. kind is one of element | text | net | route | console | animation | signal | state | settled | compare | allOf | anyOf | not.

sessionId.description: Target a specific tab. Omit unless you mean one — see instructions.

since.description: Cursor (a number) from a prior act or observe result.

anyOf.description: If > 0, wait up to this many milliseconds before failing. Default: 0 (evaluate once). Capped at 55000: your MCP client aborts the request before a longer wait can return, so a bound above this would be advertised and not deliverable. To outlast it, poll — several short waits, each of which returns a verdict.

Maximum wait in milliseconds. Default: 4000, up to 600000. One call waits at most 55000 ms, because your MCP client aborts a longer request; past that it returns resume_ms, and you call again with timeout_ms: resume_ms, the same predicate, the same since, and the same intent to keep waiting.

timeout_ms.description: For action "now": If > 0, wait up to this many milliseconds before failing.

until.description: Predicate object: { kind, ...fields }. kind is one of element | text | net | route | console | animation | signal | state | settled | compare | allOf | anyOf | not.

name: reticle_assert
